ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r4.claim: The majority say the people were disbelievers; another report says they had followed Ṣāliḥ as Muslims for a time before disbelieving and hamstringing the she-camel.
ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r4.anchor: { فكذبوه } ، الجمهور على أنهم كانوا كافرين ، وروي أنهم كانوا قد أسلموا قبل ذلك وتابعوا صالحاً بمدة

ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r5.speaker: الجمهور
ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r5.claim: The majority say the people were disbelievers.
ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r5.anchor: { فكذبوه } ، الجمهور على أنهم كانوا كافرين

ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r6.speaker: قيل
ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r6.claim: Another report says the people had become Muslims and followed Ṣāliḥ for a time before disbelieving and hamstringing the she-camel.
ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r6.anchor: وروي أنهم كانوا قد أسلموا قبل ذلك وتابعوا صالحاً بمدة ، ثم كذبوا وعقروا

ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r7.speaker: الجمهور وابن الزبير
ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r7.claim: The majority read fa-damdama; Ibn al-Zubayr reads qad hadama, with hāʾ inserted, conveying the punishment’s repeated covering of them.
ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r7.anchor: وقرأ الجمهور : { فدمدم } بميم بعد دالين ؛ وابن الزبير : قد هدم بهاء بينهما ، أي أطبق عليهم العذاب مكرراً ذلك عليهم

ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r8.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r8.claim: The phrase warns of the consequences of sins.
ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r8.anchor: { بذنبهم } : فيه تخويف من عاقبة الذنوب

ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r9.speaker: قيل
ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r9.claim: One view says God leveled the tribe in destruction; the feminine pronoun refers back to the tribe.
ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r9.anchor: { فسواها } ، قيل : فسوى القبيلة في الهلاك ، عاد عليها بالتأنيث كما عاد في { بطغواها }

ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r10.speaker: قيل
ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r10.claim: Another view says He made the devastation equal among them, sparing neither young nor old.
ABUHAYYAN:91:14/r10.anchor: وقيل : سوى الدمدمة ، أي سواها بينهم ، فلم يفلت منهم صغيراً ولا كبيراً

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p45/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p45/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p45/r1.claim: Because the whole people approved the killing, the Qur'an attributes the act to all of them, as also in 7:77 and 91:14.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p45/r1.anchor: ولما كانوا راضين، نسب ذلك إليهم في قوله: فعقروا الناقة

ALUSI:91:14/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:91:14/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI:91:14/r1.claim: They denied his warning about punishment; the denial may target an unstated prediction or the report implicit in the warning.
ALUSI:91:14/r1.anchor: أي في وعيده إياهم كما حكي عنه بقوله تعالى

ALUSI:91:14/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:91:14/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI:91:14/r2.claim: A sound alternative is that Salih reported God's command about the she-camel and watering, and they denied that divine report.
ALUSI:91:14/r2.anchor: كما يؤذن بذلك التعبير عنه عليه السلام بعنوان الرسالة ومآل ذلك أنه قال لهم

ALUSI:91:14/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:91:14/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI:91:14/r3.claim: Aqaruha means they slaughtered or killed her; the plural pronoun refers to the worst one, expressed collectively because everyone approved his act.
ALUSI:91:14/r3.anchor: أي فنحروها أو فقتلوها وضمير الجمع للأشقى

ALUSI:91:14/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:91:14/r4.speaker: قتادة
ALUSI:91:14/r4.claim: Qatāda says they did not hamstring her until their young and old, men and women, had followed and consented.
ALUSI:91:14/r4.anchor: قال قتادة بلغنا أنه لم يعقرها حتى تابعه صغيرهم وكبيرهم وذكرهم وأنثاهم

ALUSI:91:14/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:91:14/r5.speaker: author
ALUSI:91:14/r5.claim: The Lord enveloped them in punishment; the repeated form is analyzed as faʿfal and the phrase as covering or applying something over another.
ALUSI:91:14/r5.anchor: فأطبق عليهم العذاب وقالوا دمدم عليه القبر أي أطبقه وهو مما تكرر فيه الفاء

ALUSI:91:14/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:91:14/r6.speaker: القاموس
ALUSI:91:14/r6.claim: Al-Qāmūs glosses the expression as completing the punishment against them.
ALUSI:91:14/r6.anchor: وقال في «القاموس » معناه أتم العذاب عليهم

ALUSI:91:14/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:91:14/r7.speaker: مؤرج
ALUSI:91:14/r7.claim: Muʾarrij defines damdama as destruction that exterminates completely.

ALUSI:91:14/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:91:14/r8.speaker: الصحاح
ALUSI:91:14/r8.claim: Al-Ṣiḥāḥ glosses damdama as pressing something to the earth and crushing it.
ALUSI:91:14/r8.anchor: وفي الصحاح دمدمت الشيء ألزقته بالأرض وطحطحته

ALUSI:91:14/r9.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:91:14/r9.speaker: ابن الزبير
ALUSI:91:14/r9.claim: Ibn al-Zubayr reads fa-dahdama, inserting hāʾ between the dāls, with the same meaning.
ALUSI:91:14/r9.anchor: وقرأ ابن الزبير فدهدم بهاء بين الدالين والمعنى كما تقدم

ALUSI:91:14/r10.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:91:14/r10.speaker: author
ALUSI:91:14/r10.claim: The punishment came because of their sin; stating the cause despite the preceding fa warns every sinner about sin's consequence.
ALUSI:91:14/r10.anchor: بسبب ذنبهم المحكي والتصريح بذلك مع دلالة الفاء عليه للإنذار بعاقبة الذنب

ALUSI:91:14/r11.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:91:14/r11.speaker: author
ALUSI:91:14/r11.claim: If the pronoun refers to the implied punishment, God made its effects equal among them so none escaped, young or old.
ALUSI:91:14/r11.anchor: الضمير للدمدمة المفهومة من دمدم أي فجعل الدمدمة سواء بينهم

ALUSI:91:14/r12.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:91:14/r12.speaker: author
ALUSI:91:14/r12.claim: Alternatively it refers to Thamud as a tribe, with feminine agreement as in ṭaghwāhā and ashqāhā; none escaped.
ALUSI:91:14/r12.anchor: أو هو لثمود والتأنيث باعتبار القبيلة كما في طغواها وأشقاها

ALUSI:91:14/r13.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:91:14/r13.speaker: author
ALUSI:91:14/r13.claim: Another interpretation is that God levelled them with the ground.

BAGHAWI:91:14/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:91:14/r1.speaker: author
BAGHAWI:91:14/r1.claim: They denied Salih and hamstrung the she-camel.
BAGHAWI:91:14/r1.anchor: فكذبوه } يعني صالحاً ،   { فعقروها } يعني الناقة

BAGHAWI:91:14/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:91:14/r2.speaker: عطاء ومقاتل
BAGHAWI:91:14/r2.claim: Ata and Muqatil explain damdama as God destroying and annihilating them.
BAGHAWI:91:14/r2.anchor: قال عطاء ومقاتل : فدمر عليهم ربهم فأهلكهم

BAGHAWI:91:14/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:91:14/r3.speaker: المدرج
BAGHAWI:91:14/r3.claim: Al-Mudarrij defines damdama as annihilation that leaves nothing.

BAGHAWI:91:14/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:91:14/r4.speaker: author
BAGHAWI:91:14/r4.claim: Their sin was denying the Messenger and hamstringing the she-camel.

BAGHAWI:91:14/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:91:14/r5.speaker: author
BAGHAWI:91:14/r5.claim: The punishment engulfed all of them, and none escaped.
BAGHAWI:91:14/r5.anchor: فسواها } الدمدمة عليهم جميعاً ،   وعمهم بها فلم يفلت منهم أحد

BAGHAWI:91:14/r6.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:91:14/r6.speaker: الفراء
BAGHAWI:91:14/r6.claim: Al-Farraʾ says God leveled the people by punishing young and old alike, making them equal.
BAGHAWI:91:14/r6.anchor: وقال الفراء : سوى الأمة وأنزل العذاب بصغيرها وكبيرها

BAYDAWI:91:14/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI:91:14/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI:91:14/r1.claim: They rejected his warning that punishment would come if they carried out the deed, then hamstrung the she-camel.
BAYDAWI:91:14/r1.anchor: فيما حذرهم منه من حلول العذاب إن فعلوا فعقروها

BAYDAWI:91:14/r2.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI:91:14/r2.speaker: author
BAYDAWI:91:14/r2.claim: Damdama means that punishment enclosed them; the term echoes a she-camel covered with fat.
BAYDAWI:91:14/r2.anchor: فأطبق عليهم العذاب وهو من تكرير قولهم ناقة مدمومة إذا ألبسها الشحم

BAYDAWI:91:14/r3.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI:91:14/r3.speaker: author
BAYDAWI:91:14/r3.claim: The punishment came because of their sin.

BAYDAWI:91:14/r4.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI:91:14/r4.speaker: author
BAYDAWI:91:14/r4.claim: The leveling may mean that punishment covered them alike, sparing neither young nor old, or that Thamūd themselves were leveled by annihilation.
BAYDAWI:91:14/r4.anchor: فسوى الدمدمة بينهم أو عليهم فلم يفلت منهم صغير ولا كبير أو ثمود بالإهلاك

BIQAI:91:14/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:91:14/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI:91:14/r1.claim: They rejected him because of their transgression, after his final warning about punishment; alternatively, the fa is explanatory, with intervening events before they denied him in all matters concerning the camel.
BIQAI:91:14/r1.anchor: أي أوقعوا تكذيبه بسبب طغيانهم وعقب أمره هذا الأخير

BIQAI:91:14/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:91:14/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI:91:14/r2.claim: The group shared responsibility for the camel's slaughter: some carried it out and others approved it.

BIQAI:91:14/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:91:14/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI:91:14/r3.claim: “Damdama” means complete, enveloping, annihilating punishment, pulverizing their heads swiftly and with intense anger.
BIQAI:91:14/r3.anchor: عذب عذاباً تاماً مجللاً مغطياً مطبقاً مستأصلاً

BIQAI:91:14/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:91:14/r4.speaker: الرازي
BIQAI:91:14/r4.claim: Al-Razi explains “damdama” as shaking a building until it topples.
BIQAI:91:14/r4.anchor: الرازي : والدمدمة : تحريك البناء حتى ينقلب

BIQAI:91:14/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:91:14/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI:91:14/r5.claim: The preposition “upon” conveys the punishment's severity and encompassing force; calling God their Lord recalls the beneficence they denied, intensifying the wrath as favor was withdrawn.
BIQAI:91:14/r5.anchor: ودل بأداة الاستعلاء على شدته وإحاطته فقال : { عليهم }

BIQAI:91:14/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:91:14/r6.speaker: author
BIQAI:91:14/r6.claim: The punishment came because of their sin and their shared wrongdoing over the camel.
BIQAI:91:14/r6.anchor: ولما استووا في الظلم والكفر بسبب عقر الناقة

BIQAI:91:14/r7.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:91:14/r7.speaker: author
BIQAI:91:14/r7.claim: The destruction leveled them all alike: strong and weak, active killers and consenting supporters; none escaped or died earlier, just as those guided are alike in salvation.
BIQAI:91:14/r7.anchor: فجعلها كأنها أرض بولغ في تعديلها فلم يكن فيها شيء خارج عن شيء

BIQAI:91:14/r8.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:91:14/r8.speaker: author
BIQAI:91:14/r8.claim: The author compares leveling the people to leveling the sun sworn by in this surah and the objects of the oaths that follow.
BIQAI:91:14/r8.anchor: كما سوى الشمس المقسم بها وسوى بين الناس فيها

IBNASHUR:91:13/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:91:13/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:91:13/r1.claim: The mention of the most wretched man's rising is brought forward because his act is part of their transgression and tied to denial; its placement shows their incitement, while hamstringing still followed the Messenger's warning.
IBNASHUR:91:13/r1.anchor: لأن انبعاث أشقاها لعقر الناقة جزئي من جزئيات طغواهم

IBNASHUR:91:13/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:91:13/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:91:13/r4.claim: On this sequence, the later denial rejects the threat implicit in the warning; the she-camel sign came after their first rejection, as is usual for prophetic signs and apparent in Hud.
IBNASHUR:91:13/r4.anchor: أي فيما أنذرهم به فعقروها بالتكذيب المذكور أول مرة

IBNASHUR:91:13/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:91:13/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:91:13/r5.claim: Alternatively, fāʾ gives only textual sequence, moving from a summary of Thamud's denial to its details; then ‘when their most wretched arose’ need not be treated as fronted from later.
IBNASHUR:91:13/r5.anchor: ويجوز أن تكون الفاء للترتيب الذكري المجرد وهي تفيد عطف مفصل على مجمل

IBNASHUR:91:13/r13.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:91:13/r13.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:91:13/r13.claim: The implied threat was explicit in the command not to touch the camel with harm, lest painful punishment seize them.
IBNASHUR:91:13/r13.anchor: وهو المصرح به في آية سورة الأعراف ( 73 ) في قوله

IBNASHUR:91:14/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:91:14/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:91:14/r1.claim: Calling their response denial is apt because they rejected the threat of punishment contained in the Messenger's warning, even though the warning itself was an imperative.
IBNASHUR:91:14/r1.anchor: وبهذا الاعتبار استقام التعبير عن مقابلة التحذير بالتكذيب مع أن التحذير إنشاء

IBNASHUR:91:14/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:91:14/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:91:14/r2.claim: ʿAqr wounds a camel's forelegs so pain makes it kneel for slaughter at the breast; by close association, it conventionally means slaughtering it.
IBNASHUR:91:14/r2.anchor: والعَقْر : جرح البعير في يديه ليبرك على الأرض

IBNASHUR:91:14/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:91:14/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:91:14/r3.claim: Damdama means God cried out against them in anger: the sound of the thunderclap and earthquake by which they were destroyed.
IBNASHUR:91:14/r3.anchor: أي صاح عليهم ربهم صيحة غضب . والمراد بهذه الدمدمة صوت الصاعقة والرجفة

IBNASHUR:91:14/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:91:14/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:91:14/r4.claim: The destruction by a cry is compared with the account that the people were seized by the cry.
IBNASHUR:91:14/r4.anchor: التي أهلكوا بها قال تعالى : { فأخذتهم الصيحة }

IBNASHUR:91:14/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:91:14/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:91:14/r5.claim: Attributing the cry to God is a figurative attribution of its cause, since God creates the cry and its qualities.
IBNASHUR:91:14/r5.anchor: وإسناد ذلك إلى الله مجاز عقلي لأن الله هو خالق الصيحة وكيفياتها

IBNASHUR:91:14/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:91:14/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:91:14/r6.claim: Damdama follows the quadriliteral faʿlala pattern.

IBNASHUR:91:14/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:91:14/r7.speaker: أكثر المفسرين
IBNASHUR:91:14/r7.claim: Most exegetes take damdama to mean covering them with earth, deriving it from covering a grave; repetition intensifies the sense, like kabkaba.
IBNASHUR:91:14/r7.anchor: وقال أكثر المفسرين : دمدم عليهم أطبق عليهم الأرض

IBNASHUR:91:14/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:91:14/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:91:14/r8.claim: On the ‘covered with earth’ interpretation, damdama repeats dammama for emphasis, like kabkaba.
IBNASHUR:91:14/r8.anchor: ودمدم مكرر دمم للمبالغة مثل كبكب

IBNASHUR:91:14/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:91:14/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:91:14/r9.claim: The author reads ‘then He leveled it’ as their all being alike in destruction; the feminine pronoun refers to the damdama inferred from the verb.
IBNASHUR:91:14/r9.anchor: فضمير النصب عائد إلى الدمدمة المأخوذة من

IBNASHUR:91:14/r10.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:91:14/r10.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:91:14/r10.claim: Those who read damdama as covering them with earth take ‘leveled it’ to mean flattening earth over them, hiding bodies and dwellings; the pronoun then means earth.
IBNASHUR:91:14/r10.anchor: جعل الأرض مستوية عليهم لا تظهر فيها أجسادهم ولا بلادهم

IBNASHUR:91:14/r11.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:91:14/r11.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:91:14/r11.claim: On that alternative reading, the wording resembles the image of the earth being leveled over people.
IBNASHUR:91:14/r11.anchor: وجعلوا ضمير المؤنث عائداً إلى الأرض المفهومة

IBNASHUR:91:14/r12.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:91:14/r12.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:91:14/r12.claim: There is complete paronomasia between ‘fa-sawwāhā’ here and the earlier ‘wa-mā sawwāhā’.
IBNASHUR:91:14/r12.anchor: وبين { فسواها } هنا وقوله : { وما سواها }

IBNATIYYA:91:14/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:91:14/r1.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA:91:14/r1.claim: The denial is mentioned before the hamstringing because it caused the act.
IBNATIYYA:91:14/r1.anchor: وقدم تعالى التكذيب على العقر لأنه كان سبب العقر

IBNATIYYA:91:14/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:91:14/r2.speaker: قوم
IBNATIYYA:91:14/r2.claim: One report says the people had accepted Islam and followed Salih for a time, then denied him and stumbled into wrongdoing.
IBNATIYYA:91:14/r2.anchor: ويروى أنهم كانوا قد أسلموا قبل ذلك وتابعوا صالحاً مدة ثم كذبوا وعثروا

IBNATIYYA:91:14/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:91:14/r3.speaker: جمهور المفسرين
IBNATIYYA:91:14/r3.claim: Most commentators say the people remained in disbelief throughout.
IBNATIYYA:91:14/r3.anchor: والجمهور من المفسرين على أنهم كانوا على كفرهم

IBNATIYYA:91:14/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:91:14/r4.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA:91:14/r4.claim: Damdama means that God sent down punishment upon them in a distressing, repeated fashion.
IBNATIYYA:91:14/r4.anchor: { دمدم } معناه : أنزل العقاب مقلقاً لهم مكرراً ذلك وهي الدمدمة

IBNATIYYA:91:14/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:91:14/r5.speaker: ابن الزبير
IBNATIYYA:91:14/r5.claim: A codex has fa-dahdama with hāʾ between the two dāls; Ibn al-Zubayr reads this form.
IBNATIYYA:91:14/r5.anchor: وفي بعض المصاحف «فدهدم » وهي قراءة ابن الزبير بالهاء بين الدالين

IBNATIYYA:91:14/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:91:14/r7.speaker: ابن مسعود
IBNATIYYA:91:14/r7.claim: Ibn Masud's codex reads fa-dammāhā ʿalayhim.

IBNATIYYA:91:14/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:91:14/r8.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA:91:14/r8.anchor: وقوله تعالى : { بذنبهم } أي بسبب ذنبهم

IBNATIYYA:91:14/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:91:14/r9.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA:91:14/r9.claim: God made the entire tribe equal in destruction, leaving none of them alive.
IBNATIYYA:91:14/r9.anchor: وقوله تعالى : { فسواها } ، معناه : فسوى القبيلة في الهلاك لم ينج منهم أحد

NASAFI:91:14/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:91:14/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI:91:14/r1.claim: They denied Ṣāliḥ's warning that punishment would come if they acted as they did.
NASAFI:91:14/r1.anchor: { فَكَذَّبُوهُ } فيما حذرهم منه من نزول العذاب إن فعلوا

NASAFI:91:14/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:91:14/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI:91:14/r2.claim: The whole people are credited with hamstringing the she-camel although one man did it, because they approved his act.
NASAFI:91:14/r2.anchor: { فَعَقَرُوهَا } أي الناقة أسند الفعل إليهم وإن كان العاقر واحداً

NASAFI:91:14/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:91:14/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI:91:14/r3.claim: God annihilated them because they denied the messenger and hamstrung the she-camel.
NASAFI:91:14/r3.anchor: { فَدَمْدمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ } أهلكهم هلاك استئصال { بِذَنبِهِمْ } بسبب ذنبهم

NASAFI:91:14/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:91:14/r4.speaker: author
NASAFI:91:14/r4.claim: The punishment leveled them all; neither young nor old escaped it.
NASAFI:91:14/r4.anchor: { فَسَوَّاهَا } فسوى الدمدمة عليهم لم يفلت منها صغيرهم ولا كبيرهم

QURTUBI:91:14/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:91:14/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI:91:14/r1.claim: They rejected Salih's warning that they would be punished if they hamstrung the she-camel.
QURTUBI:91:14/r1.anchor: " فكذبوه " أي كذبوا صالحا عليه السلام في قوله لهم

QURTUBI:91:14/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:91:14/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI:91:14/r2.claim: The most wretched one hamstrung the camel, but the act is attributed to the whole people because they approved it.
QURTUBI:91:14/r2.anchor: " فعقروها " أي عقرها الأشقى . وأضيف إلى الكل ، لأنهم رضوا بفعله

QURTUBI:91:14/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:91:14/r3.speaker: قتادة
QURTUBI:91:14/r3.claim: Qatada says they supported the killer before he acted, including their young and old, men and women.
QURTUBI:91:14/r3.anchor: وقال قتادة : ذكر لنا أنه لم يعقرها حتى تابعه صغيرهم وكبيرهم ، ذكرهم وأنثاهم

QURTUBI:91:14/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:91:14/r4.speaker: الفراء
QURTUBI:91:14/r4.claim: Al-Farra says two men hamstrung her; Arabic can use a singular superlative for two people, so the verse need not say أشقياها.
QURTUBI:91:14/r4.anchor: وقال الفراء : عقرها اثنان : والعرب تقول : هذان أفضل الناس

QURTUBI:91:14/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:91:14/r5.speaker: author
QURTUBI:91:14/r5.claim: God destroyed them and covered them with punishment for their sins: disbelief, denial, and hamstringing the camel.
QURTUBI:91:14/r5.anchor: قوله تعالى : " فدمدم عليهم ربهم بذنبهم " أي أهلكهم وأطبق عليهم العذاب بذنبهم الذي هو الكفر والتكذيب والعقر

QURTUBI:91:14/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:91:14/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI:91:14/r6.claim: Ibn Abbas, in a report through al-Dahhak, explains دمدم as destroyed because of their crime.
QURTUBI:91:14/r6.anchor: وروى الضحاك عن ابن عباس قال : دمدم عليهم قال : دمر عليهم ربهم

QURTUBI:91:14/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:91:14/r7.speaker: الفراء
QURTUBI:91:14/r7.claim: Al-Farra gives the sense of shaking or making them tremble.

QURTUBI:91:14/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:91:14/r8.speaker: author
QURTUBI:91:14/r8.claim: The core sense is intensifying and repeating punishment; the root also means covering something over, so repeated covering conveys thorough destruction.
QURTUBI:91:14/r8.anchor: وحقيقة الدمدمة تضعيف العذاب وترديده . ويقال : دممت على الشيء أي أطبقت عليه

QURTUBI:91:14/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:91:14/r9.speaker: المؤرج
QURTUBI:91:14/r9.claim: Al-Muʾarrij defines دمدمة as destruction by total extirpation.

QURTUBI:91:14/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:91:14/r10.speaker: الصحاح
QURTUBI:91:14/r10.claim: The lexicon al-Sihah says دمدمت الشيء means pressing it to the ground and crushing it.
QURTUBI:91:14/r10.anchor: وفي الصحاح : ودمدمت الشيء : إذا ألزقته بالأرض وطحطحته

QURTUBI:91:14/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:91:14/r11.speaker: القشيري
QURTUBI:91:14/r11.claim: Al-Qushayri explains the phrase as destroying them and burying them beneath the earth, like leveling soil over a dead person.
QURTUBI:91:14/r11.anchor: القشيري : وقيل دمدمت على الميت التراب : أي سويت عليه

QURTUBI:91:14/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:91:14/r12.speaker: ابن الأنباري
QURTUBI:91:14/r12.claim: Ibn al-Anbari says the word means anger; دمدمة can also mean unsettling speech.
QURTUBI:91:14/r12.anchor: وقال ابن الأنباري : دمدم أي غضب . والدمدمة : الكلام الذي يزعج الرجل

QURTUBI:91:14/r13.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:91:14/r13.speaker: بعض اللغويين
QURTUBI:91:14/r13.claim: Some linguists define دمدمة as persistence; Arabs also call a fat camel مدمدمة.
QURTUBI:91:14/r13.anchor: وقال بعض اللغويين : الدمدمة : الإدامة . تقول العرب : ناقة مدمدمة أي سمينة

QURTUBI:91:14/r14.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:91:14/r14.speaker: author
QURTUBI:91:14/r14.claim: One explanation is that God leveled the ground over them.

QURTUBI:91:14/r15.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:91:14/r15.speaker: author
QURTUBI:91:14/r15.claim: On the earlier interpretation, God made punishment and destruction encompass them evenly; the blast destroyed young and old alike.
QURTUBI:91:14/r15.anchor: وعلى الأول " فسواها " أي فسوى الدمدمة والإهلاك عليهم . وذلك أن الصيحة أهلكتهم ، فأتت على صغيرهم وكبيرهم

QURTUBI:91:14/r16.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:91:14/r16.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI:91:14/r16.claim: Another interpretation is that punishment was equal across the people, low and high, young and old, men and women.
QURTUBI:91:14/r16.anchor: وقيل : " فسواها " أي فسوى الأمة في إنزال العذاب بهم ، صغيرهم وكبيرهم ، وضيعهم وشريفهم ، وذكرهم وأنثاهم

QURTUBI:91:14/r17.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:91:14/r17.speaker: ابن الزبير
QURTUBI:91:14/r17.claim: Ibn al-Zubayr reads فدمدم in an alternate form; Qurtubi calls the forms two dialects, like امتقع and انتقع.
QURTUBI:91:14/r17.anchor: وقرأ ابن الزبير " فدمدم " وهما لغتان . كما يقال : امتقع لونه وانتقع

RAZI:91:14/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:91:14/r1.speaker: author
RAZI:91:14/r1.claim: They did not refrain from denying Ṣāliḥ and killing the she-camel despite God’s warning of punishment.
RAZI:91:14/r1.anchor: ثم بين تعالى أن القوم لم يمتنعوا عن تكذيب صالح

RAZI:91:14/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:91:14/r2.speaker: author
RAZI:91:14/r2.claim: Qudār may have performed the killing directly, while the deed is also attributed to the group because they approved it; the direct attribution is paralleled elsewhere.
RAZI:91:14/r2.anchor: ثم يجوز أن يكون المباشر للعقر واحدا وهو قدار

RAZI:91:14/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:91:14/r3.speaker: قتادة
RAZI:91:14/r3.claim: Qatāda says the people would not kill the she-camel until young and old, men and women, had pledged to do so; this was the majority view of exegetes.
RAZI:91:14/r3.anchor: قال قتادة : ذكر لنا أنه أبى أن يعقرها

RAZI:91:14/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:91:14/r4.speaker: الفراء
RAZI:91:14/r4.claim: Al-Farrāʾ reports the view that there were two perpetrators.
RAZI:91:14/r4.anchor: وقال الفراء : قيل إنهما كانا اثنين

RAZI:91:14/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:91:14/r5.speaker: الزجاج
RAZI:91:14/r5.claim: Al-Zajjāj glosses damdama as enclosing them with punishment; repeated application covers them all around, like something smeared over every side.
RAZI:91:14/r5.anchor: قال الزجاج : معنى دمدم أطبق عليهم العذاب

RAZI:91:14/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:91:14/r6.speaker: الواحدي
RAZI:91:14/r6.claim: Al-Wāḥidī says dam means smearing or staining, and a fat thing is described as though smeared with fat.
RAZI:91:14/r6.anchor: قال الواحدي : الدم في اللغة اللطخ

RAZI:91:14/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:91:14/r7.speaker: الزجاج
RAZI:91:14/r7.claim: Al-Zajjāj derives the doubled form like kabkabū and explains it as punishment enveloping everyone, as a coating stains an object on all sides.
RAZI:91:14/r7.anchor: فجعل الزجاج دمدم من هذا الحرف على التضعيف

RAZI:91:14/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:91:14/r8.speaker: author
RAZI:91:14/r8.claim: Damdama can mean burying or leveling over them, so the earth was smoothed over them after they were killed and placed beneath the soil.
RAZI:91:14/r8.anchor: تقول للشيء : يدفن دمدمت عليه ،   أي سويت عليه

RAZI:91:14/r9.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:91:14/r9.speaker: ابن الأنباري
RAZI:91:14/r9.claim: Ibn al-Anbārī says damdama means anger, and it can mean speech that agitates a man.

RAZI:91:14/r10.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:91:14/r10.speaker: ثعلب
RAZI:91:14/r10.claim: Thaʿlab transmits from Ibn al-Aʿrābī, in agreement with Al-Farrāʾ, that it means the earth shook over them.
RAZI:91:14/r10.anchor: أرجف الأرض بهم رواه ثعلب عن ابن الأعرابي

RAZI:91:14/r11.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:91:14/r11.speaker: author
RAZI:91:14/r11.claim: If damdama means enveloping punishment, fasawwāhā means that the punishment covered everyone equally: Gabriel’s cry killed them, young and old alike.

RAZI:91:14/r12.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:91:14/r12.speaker: author
RAZI:91:14/r12.claim: If damdama means leveling, fasawwāhā means that the earth was leveled over them.
RAZI:91:14/r12.anchor: وإن فسرناها بالتسوية ،   كان المراد فسوى عليهم الأرض
